title: Bartenders
description: Mix and serve drinks to patrons, directly or through waitstaff.

tasks.text: Clean glasses, utensils, and bar equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dishwashing of physical tableware

tasks.text: Collect money for drinks served.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Billing and payment processing largely automated

tasks.text: Balance cash receipts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Balancing receipts is arithmetic, human handles discrepancies

tasks.text: Check identification of customers to verify age requirements for purchase of alcohol.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcing rules requires human presence and authority

tasks.text: Clean bars, work areas, and tables.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of food service surfaces

tasks.text: Attempt to limit problems and liability related to customers' excessive drinking by taking steps such as persuading customers to stop drinking, or ordering taxis or other transportation for intoxicated patrons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Satisfaction requires human relationship and accountability

dwas.name: Communicate with customers to resolve complaints or ensure satisfaction.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Take beverage orders from serving staff or directly from patrons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order taking automatable; customer rapport partly human

tasks.text: Serve wine, and bottled or draft beer.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Carrying and serving food by hand

tasks.text: Plan, organize, and control the operations of a cocktail lounge or bar.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Food service management is live operational leadership

dwas.name: Manage food service operations or parts of operations.

tasks.text: Stock bar with beer, wine, liquor, and related supplies such as ice, glassware, napkins, or straws.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically stocking serving stations and dining areas

dwas.name: Stock serving stations or dining areas with food or supplies.

tasks.text: Serve snacks or food items to customers seated at the bar.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Carrying and serving food by hand

tasks.text: Mix ingredients, such as liquor, soda, water, sugar, and bitters, to prepare cocktails and other drinks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical mixing of ingredients by hand

tasks.text: Slice and pit fruit for garnishing drinks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual food preparation

dwas.name: Prepare foods for cooking or serving.

tasks.text: Ask customers who become loud and obnoxious to leave, or physically remove them.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Enforcing rules requires human presence and authority

tasks.text: Arrange bottles and glasses to make attractive displays.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically arranging tables and furniture

tasks.text: Create drink recipes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Recipe ideas generated; taste and kitchen execution human

dwas.name: Create new recipes or food presentations.

tasks.text: Supervise the work of bar staff and other bartenders.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Coordinating food service staff is live supervisory work

dwas.name: Coordinate activities of food service staff.

tasks.text: Order or requisition liquors and supplies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Plan bar menus.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Menu drafts aided; cost and kitchen constraints human

tasks.text: Prepare appetizers such as pickles, cheese, and cold meats.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cooking requires hands-on manipulation of real food

emerging_tasks.task: Provide customers with directions or answers to questions.
